task_prompts.ufo-504378c6: When parsing or building query strings, keys that contain an encoded space aren't decoded/encoded correctly. For example, `decodeQueryKey('key+with+space')` currently returns `"key+with+space"` instead of `"key with space"`, and `withQuery('/', { 'key with space': 'spaced value' })` should produce `/?key+with+space=spaced+value` but doesn't encode the space in the key properly. Please fix query key decoding/encoding so spaces in keys round-trip correctly.
task_prompts.ufo-0e060c7f:
`joinURL` doesn't handle path segments that start with `./`. For example:
```js
joinURL('/', './')      // expected '/'
joinURL('/', './foo')  // expected '/foo'
joinURL('/', './foo', 'bar') // expected '/foo/bar'
```
Currently the leading `./` isn't stripped properly and the joined result comes out wrong. Please fix `joinURL` to handle leading dot segments correctly.
task_prompts.ufo-3bfbf5ac:
`parseURL` produces wrong results for `data:` and `blob:` URLs, apparently because it tries to split off a host using `//` even though these protocols don't have an authority component. For example:
```js
parseURL('data:image/png;base64,aaa//bbbbbb/ccc')
// expected protocol: 'data:', host: '', pathname: 'image/png;base64,aaa//bbbbbb/ccc'

parseURL('blob:https://video_url')
// expected protocol: 'blob:', host: '', pathname: 'https://video_url'
```
Instead the presence of `//` in the data/pathname seems to be misinterpreted as a host separator. Please fix `parseURL` to handle `data:` and `blob:` URLs correctly.
task_prompts.ufo-c9e385ec: URLs that have a leading control character (e.g. a NUL byte) or leading whitespace before the protocol aren't recognized as having a protocol, even though browsers still treat them as such — this is a known way to sneak a `javascript:` URL past naive checks. For example, `hasProtocol('\0javascript:alert(true)')` currently returns `false` instead of `true`, and `parseURL('\0https://invalid.com')` doesn't parse out the host correctly. There should also be a way to determine whether a given protocol string is one that can execute script/data content (`javascript:`, `data:`, `vbscript:`, `blob:`), e.g. `isScriptProtocol('blob:')` should return `true`. Please fix protocol detection to ignore leading whitespace/control characters and add proper script-protocol detection.
task_prompts.ufo-768210a3:
`parseURL` doesn't normalize the protocol's letter case, so URLs with a mixed-case scheme produce an inconsistent `protocol` value. For example:
```js
parseURL('Https://domain.test:3000#owo').protocol // currently 'Https:', expected 'https:'
parseURL("javascrIpt:alert('hello')").protocol // currently 'javascrIpt:', expected 'javascript:'
```
Please make `parseURL` parse and return the protocol case-insensitively (normalized to lowercase).
task_prompts.ufo-f4c0400d:
`withTrailingSlash` and `withoutTrailingSlash` mishandle URLs that include a `#fragment` — the trailing slash ends up added/removed relative to the wrong part of the URL, or the fragment interacts incorrectly with the slash logic. For example:
```js
withTrailingSlash('bar#abc') // expected 'bar#abc/'
withTrailingSlash('foo?123#abc', true) // expected 'foo/?123#abc'
withoutTrailingSlash('bar/#abc', true) // expected 'bar#abc'
withoutTrailingSlash('/a/#abc', true) // expected '/a#abc'
```
Please fix these functions so they respect the fragment correctly, with and without the query-params option enabled.
task_prompts.ufo-229e83e6:
parseURL incorrectly treats a colon appearing in the pathname of a regular http(s) URL as if it were a Windows drive letter, corrupting the parsed pathname. For example:

parseURL("https://test.com/t:est")

should produce pathname "/t:est", but the drive-letter normalization logic seems to kick in even though the protocol isn't "file://". Please fix parseURL so that drive-letter normalization only applies for the file:// protocol.
task_prompts.ufo-4d024df0:
getQuery/parseQuery returns a plain object for parsed query parameters, which means query keys that collide with Object.prototype properties behave unexpectedly. For example:

getQuery("http://foo.com/?toString=foo")

should return `{ toString: "foo" }` as an own property, but instead `toString` resolves to the inherited Object.prototype method rather than the parsed value. Please fix parseQuery so query keys can't collide with inherited Object.prototype properties.
task_prompts.ufo-7959de5b:
parseFilename throws when called without an options argument. For example:

parseFilename("/path/to/filename.ext")

should return "filename.ext", but calling it without passing an options object currently errors because it tries to access a property on the missing options argument. Please fix parseFilename so it works correctly when called with no options.
task_prompts.ufo-eb299454:
withBase and withoutBase incorrectly treat paths that merely share a text prefix with the base as already containing the base, rather than requiring a proper path-segment match. For example:

withBase("/admin-dashboard", "/admin/") // expected: "/admin/admin-dashboard"
withoutBase("/admin-dashboard", "/admin/") // expected: "/admin-dashboard"

Currently "/admin-dashboard" is being mistaken for something already under "/admin" (or vice versa) just because the strings share the "/admin" prefix, even though "/admin-dashboard" is a different path segment than "/admin". Please fix withBase and withoutBase so prefix matching respects path segment boundaries regardless of whether the base has a trailing slash.
